title: Lab 1: Security Hygiene
summary: Learn the importance of passwords, updates, backups, and safe browsing habits.

steps.title: Create a stronger password
steps.content: Use a long password with mixed letters, numbers, and symbols. Avoid reusing the same password on multiple sites.

steps.title: Turn on multi-factor authentication
steps.content: Enable MFA on email and social accounts if available. This adds a second step to unauthorized access attempts.

steps.title: Review software updates
steps.content: Check whether your operating system and browser are updated. Updates often fix important security vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Check your backup strategy
steps.content: Create a backup plan for important files so data is not lost during accidental deletion or attacks.

deliverables: A short checklist of 5 secure habits you will apply
At least one account protected with MFA
A note of your updated backup plan
tips: Use a password manager when possible.

title: Lab 2: Recognizing Phishing
summary: Learn how to detect suspicious emails and messages before clicking links or downloading files.
objectives: Identify red flags in phishing attempts

steps.title: Review example messages
steps.content: Read several email examples and highlight suspicious details such as urgent wording, mismatched sender names, and strange links.

steps.title: Check the website domain
steps.content: Verify the domain of a link before clicking and compare it with official company or platform domains.

steps.title: Report suspicious content
steps.content: Use your organization’s reporting process or the platform’s phishing tools when a message looks unsafe.

deliverables: A list of 5 warning signs to watch for
A brief summary of how you would respond
tips: Do not click links directly from suspicious messages.
If unsure, verify the source through an official website or direct contact.

title: Lab 1: Reconnaissance in a Safe Environment
summary: Practice controlled reconnaissance and learn the safe methods used in professional ethical testing.
objectives: Use safe and approved tools in a controlled environment

steps.title: Define your scope
steps.content: List the target assets, allowed methods, and time limit for your testing environment.

steps.title: Collect public information
steps.content: Gather public details only from safe and authorized systems. Focus on information relevant to the test goal.

steps.title: Document findings
steps.content: Record the data collected, any risks identified, and how those results can support remediation.

deliverables: A list of approved next steps
tips: Only test assets you own or have explicit permission to assess.
Document your methods to stay ethical and accountable.
